extName.message: Tarjuman — Your translation over the video

extDescription.message: Save subtitles as SRT to translate with any AI model, from any language to yours, then show them over the video to adjust and edit.

cmdDisplayMode.message: Switch display mode between translation only, translation over original, and hidden

cmdOffsetEarlier.message: Show the translation one step earlier

cmdOffsetLater.message: Show the translation one step later

cmdMarkReview.message: Mark the visible line for review

cmdReplayLine.message: Replay line: jump to the start of the visible line, or the last line that started
